item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 High-energy neutron irradiation reconstructs single-crystal LiNi0.92Co0.06Mn0.02O2, creating a proposed 3D Li+ percolation network via grain boundaries plus interwoven layered/rock-salt nanodomains. This dual architecture shortens diffusion paths, suppresses phase transitions and side reactions, delivering 213.9 mAh/g at 0.2 C and 80.0% retention after 450 cycles at 5 C—establishing neutron irradiation as a novel cathode engineering strategy.

item.title: Grain Boundary Character Governs Lithium Deposition Uniformity on Polycrystalline Copper
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work first identifies grain boundary density and character—not just crystallographic orientation—as key regulators of Li deposition uniformity on copper. By decoupling grain size from surface chemistry, it shows disordered boundaries impede Li adatom migration, while ordered boundaries enable redistribution. This enables engineered copper foils with uniform Li plating and improved anode-free cell cyclability.
🏷 lithium metal anode · grain boundaries · copper current collector · anode-free battery · Li deposition

item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Pressure-driven thermomechanical sintering reconfigures semi-coke’s aromatic topology, suppressing graphitization while creating twisted pseudo-graphitic domains and closed nanopores. This yields fast-charging hard carbon (80% SOC in 14.4 min) with 90.1% plateau-capacity retention via abundant Na+ sites, rapid diffusion, and stable NaF-rich SEI. It establishes a scalable route to upgrade cheap semi-coke into high-performance anodes.
🏷 hard carbon · sodium-ion battery · fast charging · plateau capacity · topological reconfiguration

item.title: Storage‐Environment‐Dependent Surface Evolution and Electrochemical Degradation of High‐Nickel NCM Single‐Crystal Cathodes
item.description:
این پژوهش نشان می‌دهد که محیط نگهداری (CO2 و هوای مرطوب) و افزایش نیکل در کاتدهای تک‌کریستال NCM باعث تشکیل لیتیوم باقیمانده و تخریب ساختاری می‌شود که امپدانس را افزایش و ظرفیت را کاهش می‌دهد.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study reveals how storage atmospheres (CO₂, humid air vs. vacuum, argon) drive residual lithium formation and surface reconstruction on high-nickel single-crystal NCM cathodes, showing nickel content exacerbates degradation. It links storage-induced surface chemistry to increased impedance and capacity loss, offering practical guidance for storage protocols to preserve electrochemical performance of high-energy-density cathodes.
🏷 single-crystal NCM · residual lithium · storage degradation · surface reconstruction · high-nickel cathode

item.title: Electrospinning‐Enabled Functional Components for Advanced Zinc‐Based Batteries: From Structural Design to Interface Regulation
item.description:
این مرور، پیشرفت‌های نانوالیاف الکتروریسی‌شده برای باتری‌های روی را از منظر تنظیم هم‌افزای یون-فضا-سطح مشترک بررسی می‌کند و روابط ساختار-عملکرد را برای طراحی مواد پیشرفته ارائه می‌دهد.
Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely frames electrospun nanofibers for zinc-based batteries through ion-spatial-interfacial synergistic regulation. It links electrospinning strategies—porous, hollow, multichannel, core–shell, hierarchical—to electrochemical function, and systematically covers anodes, cathodes, separators, electrolytes, and air electrodes. By distilling structure-function relationships, it offers rational design guidance for advanced zinc-based energy storage.
🏷 zinc-based batteries · electrospun nanofibers · interface regulation · ion transport · dendrite suppression
